reviews.title: Listen to the Voice of the Customer
reviews.text: Many companies take the time to listen to what their customers have to say because it helps them improve on the experience for them, and it also helps them improve their product or service.  Not so with Punchbowl, if you cancel your membership, they’re interested to know why but they keep your money and as a consolation, prize you get to work with and use a product that you don’t like or didn’t work for you you for a whole year!  This ensures that your word-of-mouth will not be good!  Maybe a better approach would be to give a prorated refund based on the cancellation date this way the customer is not getting more of a refund than what they used of the program and Punchbowl is not out for more than they provided.  If a company has to make money using this tactic, it makes you wonder how good the product must be to begin with……

reviews.title: Not truly free
reviews.text: If this app gave you invites without ads for free then I’d give it more stars, but it’s not truly free. I’m not spending the amount of money they’re asking for a subscription for only a few invitations. If they’d offer the opportunity to buy the invites that you want, I would’ve given them a higher rating. I wasn’t given that option. I also don’t like that the option to go ad free isn’t given until the end. Very deceptive.

reviews.title: Could not attach a gift card
reviews.text: I tried to add a gift card to this and kept getting error messages.

reviews.title: Money Grab
reviews.text:
I’ve been a paid Punchbowl subscriber for years, but I finally canceled. Over time, they’ve steadily removed features from my subscription and moved them behind more expensive membership tiers. The latest was the ability to schedule deliveries—a feature I previously had and regularly used.

When I contacted customer support to express my frustration about paying the same while receiving less, their response was essentially instructions on how to cancel my subscription. No attempt to address the concern or retain a longtime customer.

Message received. I canceled. Very disappointing way to treat loyal, paying customers.

reviews.title: Buggy but eventually worked
reviews.text: Often the buttons on pages don’t work, got a spinning wheel of loading when trying to sign up with google. Formatting the design has too few options, for example I could not easily move the invite text to keep it from blending into the background. Had to fix it by making empty text boxes under the text. Also in the app there are no names on the fonts, and it’s a bigger problem than you think it would be. There are dozens of fonts and they are not grouped by type. But there is no way to make sure you’re using the same font on different text boxes unless you COUNT through the line of fonts to match them.
